data_fields.name: inventory_size
data_fields.donor_constant: type.size per inventory type (values not read)

best_idea: Make every item move one server transaction that checks the target fits before it removes from the source, and returns requested and completed counts, so the caller places, spills or refuses the rest with no silent loss.
decision_why: Take the result shape (requested, completed, slots written) and the all-or-nothing versus partial flag. Do not take the donor's remove-first move order or its uncert path, which can lose items (InvOps.ts:591-599), and do not copy revert or transfer, which are unused and wrong for removes.
acceptance: A server test: an all-or-nothing move of 10 units into room for 4 changes neither inventory; a partial move of 10 into room for 4 moves 4 and leaves 6 in the source with no floor spill; a move of 10 when the source holds 4 moves 4 and spills 0; a stake move between two players moves all or nothing.
